srid.description:
Coordinate system for points stored in geometry column.

Interesting SRIDS:
   0 (Unknown)
   4326 (e.g. WGS84 Lat/Long - Used by Google Earth)
   3857 (e.g. Spherical Mercator - Used by Google Maps)

x.description: The X coordinate of the point. In most long/lat systems, this is the longitude.

y.description: The Y coordinate of the point. In most long/lat systems, this is the latitude.

z.description:
The Z coordinate of the point.In most long/lat systems, this is a radius from the center of the earth,
or the height / elevation over the ground.
